```{r cars}

library(dplyr)
library(readr)

# 1. Load the dataset

df <- readRDS("data_ml_causal_0607.rds")

# 2. Set seed for reproducibility
set.seed(12345)

# 3. Calculate patient volume per center and shuffle randomly
centers_volumetry <- df %>%
  group_by(site_abbreviation) %>%
  summarise(n_patients = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  sample_frac(1L) %>% 
  mutate(cumulative_patients = cumsum(n_patients))

# 4. Identify centers for the external validation cohort
# Select centers until the cumulative sum strictly exceeds 1000 patients
threshold_index <- which(centers_volumetry$cumulative_patients > 1000)[1]
validation_sites <- centers_volumetry$site_abbreviation[1:threshold_index]

# 5. Create the two distinct cohorts (geographical split)
validation_set <- df %>%
  filter(site_abbreviation %in% validation_sites)

training_set <- df %>%
  filter(!(site_abbreviation %in% validation_sites))

# 6. Verification of the spatial split
cat("\n--- SPATIAL SPLIT REPORT ---\n")
cat("Number of centers in the training set:", length(unique(training_set$site_abbreviation)), "\n")
cat("Number of patients in the training set:", nrow(training_set), "\n")
cat("Number of centers in the validation set:", length(unique(validation_set$site_abbreviation)), "\n")
cat("Number of patients in the validation set:", nrow(validation_set), "\n")

# 7. Quality control: check for data leakage across sets
leakage_check <- intersect(unique(training_set$site_abbreviation), unique(validation_set$site_abbreviation))

if(length(leakage_check) == 0) {
  cat("Spatial independence status: VALID (No overlapping centers)\n")
} else {
  cat("WARNING: Data leakage detected between the sets.\n")
}
```

```{r}
# 2. OUTCOME DEFINITIONS
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Primary and secondary outcomes are strictly defined to evaluate both 
# clinical efficacy and safety (competing risk of mortality).

primary_outcome <- "VFD_28"
secondary_outcomes <- c("VAPFD_28", "mortality_28d")

# We define a vector of all variables that must be strictly excluded 
# from the covariate pool to prevent target leakage.
leakage_variables <- c("VAP_status", primary_outcome, secondary_outcomes, "site_abbreviation")


# 3. TREATMENT AND COVARIATES DEFINITION
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# List of all VAP prevention measures evaluated in the cohort
all_prevention_measures <- c(
  "SODD", 
  "bed_elevation", 
  "sedation_vacation", 
  "thrombosis_proph", 
  "ulcer_proph", 
  "oral_care"
)

# Select the target treatment (W) for the current causal analysis.
# Example set to SODD. This can be iterated in a loop for other measures.
target_treatment <- "oral_care"

# The remaining prevention measures are defined as baseline covariates.
# This adjustment is critical to isolate the specific effect of W 
# from the synergistic effect of the VAP care bundle.
other_prevention_measures <- setdiff(all_prevention_measures, target_treatment)

# Define the baseline clinical covariates (patient status at or before ICU admission)
x_prel <- c(
  # Demographic and Historical Variables
  "AGE", "SEX", "Myocardial_infarction", "congestive_heart_failure", 
  "peripherical_vascular_disease", "COPD", "connective_tissue_disease", 
  "peptic_ulcer_disease", "liver_disease", "diabetes_mellitus", 
  "CKD", "solid_tumor", "AIDS", "CVA_TIA_hemiplegia", 
  "malignant_hemopathies", "CCI_score", 
  
  # Severity and Exposure Variables
  "ICU_admission", "SOFA", "APACHE_II", "Duration_days_before_ICU", 
  
  # Pharmacological Treatments (Potential Confounders)
  "Prescription_of_ATB", "Prescription_of_IS", "LT_corticosteroids", 
  "calcineurin", "mTOR", "selective_IS", "mAB", "cancer_chemo", "other_IS"
)

# Construct the final covariate matrix X
covariates_X <- c(x_prel, other_prevention_measures)

# 4. METHODOLOGICAL QUALITY CONTROL
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Strictly verify that no outcome or site indicator has leaked into matrix X.

cat("\n--- CAUSAL PIPELINE: VARIABLE ALLOCATION REPORT ---\n")
cat("Target Treatment (W):", target_treatment, "\n")
cat("Primary Outcome (Y):", primary_outcome, "\n")
cat("Number of baseline covariates in X:", length(covariates_X), "\n")

leakage_check <- intersect(covariates_X, leakage_variables)

if (length(leakage_check) > 0) {
  stop("FATAL ERROR: Target leakage detected. Do not proceed with modeling.")
} else {
  cat("Integrity Check: PASSED. Zero target leakage in covariate matrix X.\n")
}
```


```{r}
# Load necessary libraries for preprocessing and balancing
library(caret)      # For feature cleaning and cross-validated KNN imputation
library(WeightIt)   # For Propensity Score and IPW calculation
library(cobalt)     # For covariate balance diagnostics (Love plots)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(recipes)    # State-of-the-art preprocessing and imputation
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. PREPROCESSING (UPDATED WITH RECIPES)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("\n--- PIPELINE STEP 4: PREPROCESSING & IMPUTATION ---\n")

training_set <- training_set %>% drop_na(all_of(target_treatment))
validation_set <- validation_set %>% drop_na(all_of(target_treatment))

cat("Patients with missing treatment assignment excluded.\n")

# A. Feature Cleaning (Zero-variance and high correlation)
X_train_raw <- training_set[, covariates_X]
X_valid_raw <- validation_set[, covariates_X]

nzv_info <- caret::nearZeroVar(X_train_raw, saveMetrics = TRUE)
nzv_vars <- rownames(nzv_info[nzv_info$nzv == TRUE, ])
cat("Removed zero-variance variables:", length(nzv_vars), "\n")

covariates_cleaned <- setdiff(covariates_X, nzv_vars)

# B. Missing Data Imputation (k-NN) using 'recipes'
cat("Fitting k-NN imputation model on Training set (k=5)...\n")

imputation_formula <- as.formula(paste("~", paste(c(covariates_cleaned, target_treatment), collapse = "+")))

knn_recipe <- recipe(imputation_formula, data = training_set) %>%
  step_impute_knn(all_of(covariates_cleaned), neighbors = 5)

knn_prep <- prep(knn_recipe, training = training_set)

train_imputed <- bake(knn_prep, new_data = training_set)
valid_imputed <- bake(knn_prep, new_data = validation_set)

train_imputed[[target_treatment]] <- as.factor(train_imputed[[target_treatment]])
valid_imputed[[target_treatment]] <- as.factor(valid_imputed[[target_treatment]])

# C. Re-bind Outcomes
train_full <- bind_cols(train_imputed, training_set[, c(primary_outcome, secondary_outcomes)])
valid_full <- bind_cols(valid_imputed, validation_set[, c(primary_outcome, secondary_outcomes)])

cat("Preprocessing and Imputation complete. Ready for IPW balancing.\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. POSITIVITY AND OVERLAP (4 SCENARIOS TRAIN + 1 VALIDATION)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("\n--- PIPELINE STEP 5: POSITIVITY AND BALANCING ---\n")

apply_ipw_and_trimming <- function(data, treatment_var, cov_vars, dataset_name = "Cohort", bounds = c(0.05, 0.95)) {
  
  formula_ps <- as.formula(paste(treatment_var, "~", paste(cov_vars, collapse = "+")))
  
  # A. Propensity Score Estimation initiale
  suppressWarnings({
    ps_model <- weightit(
      formula_ps,
      data = data,
      method = "ps",
      estimand = "ATE"
    )
  })
  
  data$PS <- ps_model$ps
  data$IPW <- ps_model$weights
  
  # B. Diagnostics pre trimming
  cat(sprintf("\nDiagnostics for %s (Pre-Trimming):\n", dataset_name))
  cat("Max IPW weight:", round(max(data$IPW), 2), "\n")
  
  # C. Trimming strategy
  trimmed_data <- data %>%
    filter(PS >= bounds[1] & PS <= bounds[2])
  
  trim_loss <- nrow(data) - nrow(trimmed_data)
  cat(sprintf("Patients excluded by Propensity Score trimming [%.3f, %.3f]: %d\n", bounds[1], bounds[2], trim_loss))
  
  
  suppressWarnings({
    ps_model_trimmed <- weightit(
      formula_ps,
      data = trimmed_data,
      method = "ps",
      estimand = "ATE"
    )
  })
  trimmed_data$IPW_final <- ps_model_trimmed$weights
  
  # D. Diagnostics post trimming
  mean_weight <- mean(trimmed_data$IPW_final)
  cat("Mean IPW weight post-trimming (Target < 20):", round(mean_weight, 2), "\n")
  
  # E. Standardized Mean Differences (SMD)
  bal_stats <- bal.tab(ps_model_trimmed, un = TRUE)
  max_smd <- max(abs(bal_stats$Balance$Diff.Adj), na.rm = TRUE)
  cat("Maximum Adjusted SMD (Target < 0.1):", round(max_smd, 3), "\n")
  
  return(list(data = trimmed_data, bal_obj = ps_model_trimmed))
}

# --- GENERATION OF 4 DERIVATION DATASETS  ---

train_res_full <- apply_ipw_and_trimming(train_full, target_treatment, covariates_cleaned, 
                                         "Training Set (Full)", bounds = c(0.000, 1.000))

train_final_05 <- train_res_05$data

                                       "Training Set (10-90%)", bounds = c(0.100, 0.900))
train_final_10 <- train_res_10$data

# --- GENERATION VALIDATION DATASET  ---

                                         "Validation Set (Full)", bounds = c(0.000, 1.000))
valid_final_full <- valid_res_full$data

# 2. Validation Set (2.5-97.5%)

# --- DIAGNOSTICS  (LOVE PLOTS) ---

# Love plot  validation 2.5
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# 5.bis CALIBRATION  ( PROPENSITY SCORE )
# =============================================================================
cat("\n--- PIPELINE STEP 5.bis: PROPENSITY SCORE CALIBRATION ---\n")


evaluate_ps_calibration <- function(data, treatment_var, ps_var, dataset_name = "Cohort") {
  
  # 1. Extraction
  obs_trt <- as.numeric(as.character(data[[treatment_var]]))
  
  if(any(!obs_trt %in% c(0, 1))) {
    obs_trt <- ifelse(obs_trt == max(obs_trt, na.rm = TRUE), 1, 0)
  }
  pred_ps <- data[[ps_var]]
  
  # 2.  Brier Sore
  brier_score <- mean((pred_ps - obs_trt)^2, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  cat(sprintf("\nDiagnostics pour %s :\n", dataset_name))
  cat(sprintf("Brier Score : %.4f \n", brier_score))
  
  # 3. Preparation data for curve (deciles)
  calib_data <- data.frame(Observed = obs_trt, Predicted = pred_ps) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Predicted)) %>%
    mutate(Decile = ntile(Predicted, 10)) %>%
    group_by(Decile) %>%
    summarise(
      Mean_Predicted = mean(Predicted, na.rm = TRUE),
      Observed_Proportion = mean(Observed, na.rm = TRUE),
      Count = n(),
      .groups = 'drop'
    )
  
  # 4. Plot generation
  calib_plot <- ggplot(calib_data, aes(x = Mean_Predicted, y = Observed_Proportion)) +
    # ( perfect calibration )
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", linewidth = 0.8) +
    
 
    geom_point(color = "#2980B9", size = 3) +
    geom_line(color = "#2980B9", linewidth = 1) +
    
    #  (LOESS) 
    geom_smooth(data = data.frame(Observed = obs_trt, Predicted = pred_ps),
                aes(x = Predicted, y = Observed),
                method = "loess", se = FALSE, color = "#C0392B", linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.8) +
    
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2)) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Propensity Score Calibration -", dataset_name),
      subtitle = sprintf("Brier Score = %.3f", brier_score),
      x = "Mean Predicted Probability of Treatment",
      y = "Observed Proportion of Treatment"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12)
  
  print(calib_plot)
  
  return(list(Brier_Score = brier_score, Plot = calib_plot))
}

# --- Application  ---


calib_train <- evaluate_ps_calibration(
  data = train_final_full, 
  treatment_var = target_treatment, 
  ps_var = "PS", 
  dataset_name = "Training Set (Full)"
)


calib_valid <- evaluate_ps_calibration(
  data = valid_final_full, 
  treatment_var = target_treatment, 
  ps_var = "PS", 
  dataset_name = "Validation Set (Full)"
)
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# CLEAN-VAP — E-VALUE v7 (VanderWeele & Ding, Ann Intern Med 2017)
#
# =============================================================================

library(EValue)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ranger)

dir.create("CLEAN_VAP_outputs/evalue", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# =============================================================================
# DEFINITION OF THE ESTIMATION POPULATION (ATE)
# =============================================================================
# Exact dataset used to fit the GRFs for global effects
ate_population <- df_final

# =============================================================================
# EMPIRICAL DIAGNOSTIC — QUANTIFICATION OF THE OLS LIMIT (SAP documentation)
# =============================================================================
cat("\n=== EMPIRICAL DIAGNOSTIC — VAPFD_28 / VFD_28 (SAP documentation) ===\n")

diagnostic_normality <- function(var, data, label) {
  x <- data[[var]]
  pct_zero <- mean(x == 0,  na.rm = TRUE) * 100
  pct_max  <- mean(x == max(x, na.rm = TRUE), na.rm = TRUE) * 100
  pct_mass <- pct_zero + pct_max

  cat(sprintf("\n%s :\n", label))
  cat(sprintf("  Total N                : %d\n", sum(!is.na(x))))
  cat(sprintf("  %% at lower bound       : %.1f%%\n", pct_zero))
  cat(sprintf("  %% at upper bound       : %.1f%%\n", pct_max))
  cat(sprintf("  %% total mass at bounds : %.1f%%\n", pct_mass))

  data.frame(Outcome = label, Pct_zero = round(pct_zero, 1),
             Pct_max = round(pct_max, 1), Pct_mass_bounds = round(pct_mass, 1))
}

diag_vapfd <- diagnostic_normality("VAPFD_28", ate_population, "VAPFD_28")
diag_vfd   <- diagnostic_normality("VFD_28",   ate_population, "VFD_28")
diagnostic_table <- bind_rows(diag_vapfd, diag_vfd)

write.csv(diagnostic_table, "CLEAN_VAP_outputs/evalue/diagnostic_normality_continuous_outcomes.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("\nDiagnostic exported for the SAP.\n=====================================================================\n\n")

# =============================================================================
# UTILITY FUNCTIONS
# =============================================================================

clip01 <- function(p, label = "") {
  n_out <- sum(p < 0 | p > 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  clipped <- pmax(0, pmin(1, p))
  if (n_out > 0) warning(sprintf("Clipping applied for %s: %d value(s) outside [0,1].", label, n_out))
  clipped
}

safe_evalues_RR <- function(rr, rr_lo, rr_hi) {
  bounds <- sort(c(rr_lo, rr_hi))
  tryCatch({
    evalues.RR(est = rr, lo = bounds[1], hi = bounds[2])
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning("evalues.RR failed: ", conditionMessage(e)); NULL
  })
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# MANUAL WORKAROUND (SMD-to-RR) FOR THE evalues.OLS BUG
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
compute_evalue_continuous_manual <- function(est, sd_outcome, label, se = NULL, ci_lo = NULL, ci_hi = NULL) {
  est_num <- as.numeric(est)
  ci_lo_num <- as.numeric(ci_lo)
  ci_hi_num <- as.numeric(ci_hi)

  if (is.null(ci_lo_num) || is.null(ci_hi_num)) {
    se_used <- as.numeric(se)
    ci_lo_num <- est_num - 1.96 * se_used
    ci_hi_num <- est_num + 1.96 * se_used
  }

  d_est <- abs(est_num) / sd_outcome
  d_lo  <- abs(ci_lo_num) / sd_outcome
  d_hi  <- abs(ci_hi_num) / sd_outcome

  rr_est <- exp(0.91 * d_est)
  rr_lo  <- exp(0.91 * min(d_lo, d_hi))
  rr_hi  <- exp(0.91 * max(d_lo, d_hi))

  ev <- safe_evalues_RR(rr_est, rr_lo, rr_hi)

  if (!is.null(ev)) {
    evalue_point <- ev["E-values", "point"]
    evalue_ci    <- ev["E-values", "lower"]
    
    cat(sprintf("  %-50s E-val(pt)=%.2f | E-val(CI)=%.2f\n", label, evalue_point, evalue_ci))

    return(data.frame(
      Analysis = label, Type = "Continuous (SMD->RR approx)", Estimate = round(est_num, 4),
      CI_Lo = round(ci_lo_num, 4), CI_Hi = round(ci_hi_num, 4),
      Evalue_point = round(evalue_point, 2), Evalue_CI = round(evalue_ci, 2), stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }
  NULL
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# BINARY E-VALUE (OPTION B: RD -> RR)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
compute_evalue_binary <- function(ard, ci_lo, ci_hi, p0_counterfactual, label) {
  p0    <- clip01(p0_counterfactual, paste0("p0_", label))
  p1    <- clip01(p0 + ard, paste0("p1_", label))
  p1_lo <- clip01(p0 + ci_lo, paste0("p1_lo_", label))
  p1_hi <- clip01(p0 + ci_hi, paste0("p1_hi_", label))

  rr    <- p1 / p0
  rr_lo <- p1_lo / p0
  rr_hi <- p1_hi / p0

  ev <- safe_evalues_RR(rr, rr_lo, rr_hi)

  if (!is.null(ev)) {
    evalue_point <- ev["E-values", "point"]
    evalue_ci    <- ev["E-values", ifelse(ard < 0, "upper", "lower")]

    cat(sprintf("  %-50s p0=%.4f p1=%.4f | E-val(pt)=%.2f | E-val(CI)=%.2f\n",
                label, p0, p1, evalue_point, evalue_ci))

    return(data.frame(
      Analysis = label, Type = "Binary (RD converted to RR)",
      Estimate = round(ard, 4), CI_Lo = round(ci_lo, 4), CI_Hi = round(ci_hi, 4),
      Evalue_point = round(evalue_point, 2), Evalue_CI = round(evalue_ci, 2),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }
  NULL
}

extract_p0_counterfactual <- function(outcome_var, treatment_var, covariates, data, subset_idx = NULL) {
  data_sub <- if (is.null(subset_idx)) data else data[subset_idx, ]
  Y <- as.numeric(as.character(data_sub[[outcome_var]]))
  W <- as.numeric(as.character(data_sub[[treatment_var]]))
  if (any(!W %in% c(0, 1))) W <- ifelse(W == max(W), 1, 0)

  X <- data_sub[, covariates, drop = FALSE]
  df_nuis <- data.frame(X, Y = Y, W = as.factor(W))

  fit_Q0 <- ranger(Y ~ ., data = df_nuis[df_nuis$W == "0", !names(df_nuis) %in% "W"],
                   num.threads = 2, seed = 2026)
  Q0_hat <- predict(fit_Q0, data = X)$predictions
  mean(Q0_hat, na.rm = TRUE)
}

# =============================================================================
# GENERIC LOOP
# =============================================================================
compute_evalue_treatment <- function(treatment_var, ate_table, estimator_label, population, covariates) {
  cat(sprintf("\n--- %s (%s) ---\n", treatment_var, estimator_label))

  n0 <- sum(as.numeric(as.character(population[[treatment_var]])) == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  n1 <- sum(as.numeric(as.character(population[[treatment_var]])) == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  stopifnot("Error: n0 or n1 is zero. Check encoding (0/1 expected)." = n0 > 0 & n1 > 0)

  results_list <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(ate_table)), function(i) {
    row <- ate_table[i, ]
    out_name <- as.character(row$outcome)

    if (out_name == "mortality_28d") {
      p0 <- extract_p0_counterfactual(
        outcome_var = out_name, treatment_var = treatment_var,
        covariates = covariates, data = population
      )
      compute_evalue_binary(
        ard = as.numeric(row$est), ci_lo = as.numeric(row$ci_lo), ci_hi = as.numeric(row$ci_hi),
        p0_counterfactual = p0, label = sprintf("ATE (%s) %s — %s", estimator_label, treatment_var, out_name)
      )
    } else {
      sd_out <- sd(as.numeric(as.character(population[[out_name]])), na.rm = TRUE)
      
      compute_evalue_continuous_manual(
        est = as.numeric(row$est), sd_outcome = sd_out, ci_lo = as.numeric(row$ci_lo), ci_hi = as.numeric(row$ci_hi),
        label = sprintf("ATE (%s) %s — %s", estimator_label, treatment_var, out_name)
      )
    }
  })
  bind_rows(Filter(Negate(is.null), results_list))
}

# =============================================================================
# EXECUTIONS
# =============================================================================
evalue_results <- data.frame()

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. ATE ULCER PROPHYLAXIS 
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
ate_table_ulcer <- data.frame(
  outcome = c("VAPFD_28", "VFD_28", "mortality_28d"),
  est     = c(-1.27, -1.82, 0.0364),
  ci_lo   = c(-2.14, -2.57, 0.0049),
  ci_hi   = c(-0.41, -1.06, 0.0678)
)

res_ulcer <- compute_evalue_treatment(
  treatment_var = "ulcer_proph", ate_table = ate_table_ulcer, estimator_label = "GRF",
  population = ate_population, covariates = covariates_cleaned
)
evalue_results <- bind_rows(evalue_results, res_ulcer)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. ATE THROMBOSIS PROPHYLAXIS
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
ate_table_dvt <- data.frame(
  outcome = c("VAPFD_28", "VFD_28", "mortality_28d"),
  est     = c(4.44, 2.44, -0.1644),
  ci_lo   = c(3.07, 1.31, -0.2142),
  ci_hi   = c(5.80, 3.56, -0.1145)
)

res_dvt <- compute_evalue_treatment(
  treatment_var = "thrombosis_proph", ate_table = ate_table_dvt, estimator_label = "GRF",
  population = ate_population, covariates = covariates_cleaned
)
evalue_results <- bind_rows(evalue_results, res_dvt)


# =============================================================================
# 3. CATE SEDATION VACATION 
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PRELIMINARY CHECK (Traceability)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
df_cate_vapfd_check <- readRDS("Valid_2.5_97.5_with_ITE_sedation_vacation_VAPFD_28.rds")
df_cate_vapfd_check <- df_cate_vapfd_check %>% mutate(ITE_tertile = ntile(ITE_stabilized, 3))

cat("\n--- DIRECTIONALITY CHECK ITE vs VAPFD_28 ---\n")
suppressWarnings(print(cor.test(df_cate_vapfd_check$ITE_stabilized, df_cate_vapfd_check$VAPFD_28, method = "spearman")))
cat("Mean VAPFD_28 Tertile 1 (Most negative):", mean(df_cate_vapfd_check$VAPFD_28[df_cate_vapfd_check$ITE_tertile == 1], na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Mean VAPFD_28 Tertile 3 (Most positive):", mean(df_cate_vapfd_check$VAPFD_28[df_cate_vapfd_check$ITE_tertile == 3], na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3.A. CATE VAPFD_28 (Harm Signal)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n--- 3.A CATE SEDATION VACATION (VAPFD_28) ---\n")
df_cate_vapfd <- readRDS("Valid_2.5_97.5_with_ITE_sedation_vacation_VAPFD_28.rds")
df_cate_vapfd <- df_cate_vapfd %>% mutate(ITE_tertile = ntile(ITE_stabilized, 3))

target_tertile_vapfd <- 1 # Tertile 1 isolates the greatest loss of VAP-free days
pop_sed_vapfd_impact <- df_cate_vapfd %>% filter(ITE_tertile == target_tertile_vapfd)

cate_table_sedation_vapfd <- data.frame(
  outcome = "VAPFD_28", 
  est = c(-2.69), 
  ci_lo = c(-4.66), 
  ci_hi = c(-0.47)
)

res_sedation_vapfd <- compute_evalue_treatment(
  treatment_var = "sedation_vacation", 
  ate_table = cate_table_sedation_vapfd, 
  estimator_label = sprintf("CATE - Harm Signal (Tertile %d, VAPFD_28 reduction)", target_tertile_vapfd), 
  population = pop_sed_vapfd_impact, 
  covariates = covariates_cleaned
)
evalue_results <- bind_rows(evalue_results, res_sedation_vapfd)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3.B. CATE MORTALITY 28D (Harm Signal)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n--- 3.B CATE SEDATION VACATION (28D MORTALITY) ---\n")
df_cate_mort <- readRDS("Valid_10-90_with_ITE_sedation_vacation_mortality_28d.rds")
df_cate_mort <- df_cate_mort %>% mutate(ITE_tertile = ntile(ITE_stabilized, 3))

target_tertile_mort <- 3 # Tertile 3 isolates the highest mortality increase (most positive ITE)
pop_sed_mort_impact <- df_cate_mort %>% filter(ITE_tertile == target_tertile_mort)

cate_table_sedation_mort <- data.frame(
  outcome = "mortality_28d", 
  est     = c(0.1264), 
  ci_lo   = c(0.0456),
  ci_hi   = c(0.2084)  
)

res_sedation_mort <- compute_evalue_treatment(
  treatment_var = "sedation_vacation", 
  ate_table = cate_table_sedation_mort, 
  estimator_label = sprintf("CATE - Harm Signal (Tertile %d, Mortality increase)", target_tertile_mort), 
  population = pop_sed_mort_impact, 
  covariates = covariates_cleaned
)
evalue_results <- bind_rows(evalue_results, res_sedation_mort)

# =============================================================================
# SUMMARY TABLE
# =============================================================================
cat("\n--- SUMMARY TABLE ---\n")
print(evalue_results, row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(evalue_results, "CLEAN_VAP_outputs/evalue/evalue_summary_v7.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# =============================================================================
# METHODOLOGICAL JUSTIFICATION FOR THE STATISTICAL ANALYSIS PLAN (SAP)
# =============================================================================
cat("\n=== SUGGESTED SAP TEXT ===\n\n")

sap_text <- sprintf(
  "VAPFD-28 and VFD-28 exhibited %.1f%% and %.1f%% mass at boundary values (0 and 28 days), respectively, consistent with composite time-to-event endpoints commonly seen in critical care. E-values for continuous outcomes were computed using the SMD-to-RR approximation (VanderWeele & Ding, Ann Intern Med 2017, Technical Appendix) due to a reproducible internal error in EValue::evalues.OLS() (package version 4.1.4, R 4.3.1), isolated to its internal S3 dispatch and independent of the input data. Given the documented departure from normality, these E-values should be interpreted as approximate rather than exact bounds on the required unmeasured confounding strength.",
  diag_vapfd$Pct_mass_bounds, diag_vfd$Pct_mass_bounds
)

cat(sap_text, "\n\n")
writeLines(sap_text, "CLEAN_VAP_outputs/evalue/sap_justification_text.txt")
```
